(2) The scene cuts to an exterior shot of a modern white building with a blue circular logo and large characters reading '大學眼科' under a bright daytime sky. (3) The man is seen at a reception desk talking to a staff member in a green uniform, then transitions to a dimly lit examination room where he sits behind diagnostic equipment, pointing his hand in various directions while wearing a grey face mask. (5) He walks down a bright white hallway and enters a room where a female doctor in a white lab coat is sitting. He sits across from her at another eye examination machine. (6) The doctor uses a slit-lamp microscope to examine the man's eye; a digital monitor nearby displays high-resolution images of the eye's internal structures. (7) The man and the doctor sit in a well-lit office, gesturing as they engage in conversation; the man eventually smiles, claps his hands, and makes a peace sign toward the camera.
